title: License Plate Reader Policy
summary: William & Mary Police Department's official License Plate Reader Policy (O-35), effective July 2025, governs collection, use, retention, dissemination, and auditing of LPR data. It prohibits enforcement based solely on LPR alerts, requires training and login credentials, mandates 30-day internal audits, and aligns data retention with the Code of Virginia.

key_quotes.quote: Enforcement action will not be taken based solely on an LPR alert. Officers must have independent reasonable suspicion or probable cause, or confirmation of other circumstances that confirm the validity of the alert.
The Deputy Chief (or designee) shall perform an internal audit at least once every 30 days, ensuring use of the LPR system data was consistent with WMPD policy and law.
WMPD will store LPR system data consistent with the Code of Virginia. Additionally, data will be destroyed automatically within the system, in compliance with the Code.
